basic_info.description:
Live large at the Beacon! This bright, spacious unit boasts the largest one bedroom floor plan in the whole building. Plenty of storage space thanks to built-in shelves and spacious closets. In-unit washer/dryer and an updated ultra quiet Bosch dishwasher. Blazing fast fiber optic internet is available from Google Fiber.

The Beacon offers best in class amenities including a heated swimming pool, hot tub, sauna, gym, secure package delivery and 24 hour concierge. In building parking spot also available. You'll be steps from a Safeway, Gus's, Caltrain, Muni, I80, the Embarcadero, and minutes from downtown. Lots of great dining options in the area, including several Michelin star restaurants. Also close to Oracle Park and the Chase Center.

We lived here for eight years and loved every minute. We are sure you will too!

Owner pays for water and trash/recycling. Renter pays for electric and internet. Parking (we have a great spot right by the elevator) is available for an extra fee of $207.44/month. As per building rules, smoking of any kind is prohibited within the unit and common areas.
